title: 第7章 沈老夫人(2)
content_zh:
事实上，西院比起东院来，位置更偏，连带着日光也不甚充足，只有东院一半不到，实在没什么值得称道的地方。只有沈信整日乐呵呵的，得了那片空地便觉得捡了天大的便宜。沈信和沈夫人都是将门世家，眼光也一并简洁，白墙黑瓦，朴素至极。比不得东院修缮的精致婉约。
沈妙曾对自家占着的西院十分不满，羡慕东院居住的典雅可爱，为此私心里还很埋怨沈信。如今看来，却是嗤笑自己的无知。
自家院子，虽然朴素，却不简陋，处处彰显豁达心境，又哪里如东院那些牛鬼蛇神一般，不过金玉其外，败絮其中。
待拐过长长的走廊，经过修剪的精致无比的花园，才走到荣景堂门口。
大约是为了彰显书香之气，荣景堂布置的极为风雅。门口挂着竹心雅意的牌匾，松鹤做成的铜把手精巧灵动。
“五姑娘来了。”沈老夫人身边的喜儿道。
沈妙一脚踏入荣景堂。
荣景堂里是一副其乐融融的画面，人几乎都到齐了。沈家二夫人任婉云和沈家三夫人陈若秋站在老夫人下首。沈清拿着一盘点心坐在老夫人身边，另一边坐着沈家二房所出的弟弟沈元柏。沈元柏才五岁，胡乱抓着点心就要往老夫人嘴里塞，逗得沈老夫人笑的前俯后仰。
似乎没有一个人注意到沈妙的出现，直到沈玥笑着道：“五妹妹怎么现在才来，七弟都要把糖蒸酥酪吃完了。”
沈妙颔首：“身子大约还未全好，走两步有些晕，路上歇息了一阵，所以来迟了。”

荣景堂里的人都默了一默。
沈玥要说她托大来的晚，她倒也不怕点出沈老夫人倚老卖老，不顾孙女身子就要人过来请安的道理。
片刻后，任婉云笑道：“我看小五是真的身子弱，这几日大夫都请了两回，好在现在看着是无事了。”
“身子可好些了？”一个沙哑严厉的声音响起，带着一丝不易察觉的不耐。
沈妙抬头看向沈老夫人。
沈老夫人面上的笑容已经收起，有些倨傲的微微昂头。明明已经是古稀之年，偏穿着件桃红色的盘锦扣窄薄袄裙，领口镶着绿色的玉松石扣子，带着绣着白兰的抹额。满头银发盘成一个祥云髻，点缀着一些玉珠子。
她是一个对外表极其讲究的女人，上辈子，沈妙闺阁时期，一直觉得沈老夫人是最高贵的女人，那种到了晚年都优雅美丽的气质让她忍不住着迷，如今看来却觉得有些可笑。
沈老将军的原配，沈信的母亲出生名门，真正的大家闺秀，可惜中年病逝了。后沈老将军行军路过某地时从地痞手中救下一名歌女，歌女无处可去，恳请为妾，为沈老将军生下了沈贵和沈万，后来就被扶正了。
歌女熬出了头，成为了沈夫人，后来又成为了沈老夫人。名声和地位变了，可是骨子里来自市井的小人嘴脸还是一成不变。沈妙还记得上辈子，沈老夫人逼她嫁给瘸了腿的豫州王，不过是为了给沈清铺路。

她看着面前的女人，沈老夫人年轻时候生的美，脸儿尖尖，眼睛大而水灵，到了老时，便如一个干巴的三角儿鼓面，上面突兀的耸着两个眼睛。偏她还不认命，非要涂艳色的口脂。
果真是……不端庄极了。沈妙以上辈子做皇后的眼光漫不经心的在心里评价，谦卑的道：“喝了药，已经好多了，谢祖母关心。”
下一秒，便听得头上沈老夫人高声喝道：“不孝女，还不跪下！”
content_en:
In fact, the west courtyard is located in a more remote location than the east courtyard, and it does not even get enough sunlight. It is less than half of the east courtyard. There is really nothing worthy of praise. Shen Xin was the only one who was happy all day long, and felt like he had gotten a huge advantage by getting that piece of open space. Shen Xin and Mrs. Shen both come from a family of generals, and their visions are also simple. They have white walls and black tiles, and are extremely simple. It is incomparable to the exquisite and graceful renovation of the east courtyard.
Shen Miao was once very dissatisfied with the West Courtyard she occupied and envied the elegance and cuteness of the East Courtyard, so she secretly complained about Shen Xin. Now it seems that he is laughing at his own ignorance.
Although the courtyard of my house is simple, it is not shabby. It shows an open-minded attitude in every aspect. It is not like those ghosts and ghosts in the east courtyard, but they are nothing but gold and jade on the outside and shabby on the inside.
After turning around the long corridor and passing the exquisitely manicured gardens, we arrived at the entrance of Rongjing Hall.
Probably to show off the scholarly atmosphere, Rongjing Hall was decorated extremely elegantly. A plaque with an elegant bamboo heart hangs at the door, and the copper handle made of pine and crane is exquisite and flexible.
"Fifth girl is here." Xi'er said next to Mrs. Shen.
Shen Miao stepped into the Rongjing Hall.
There was a happy scene in Rongjing Hall, and almost everyone was here. The second wife of the Shen family, Ren Wanyun, and the third wife of the Shen family, Chen Rouqiu, stood under the old lady. Shen Qing sat next to the old lady with a plate of snacks, and on the other side sat Shen Yuanbai, the younger brother of the second room of the Shen family. Shen Yuanbai was only five years old. He grabbed snacks and stuffed them into the old lady's mouth, making old lady Shen laugh.
No one seemed to notice Shen Miao's appearance until Shen Yue said with a smile: "Why did fifth sister come just now? Seventh brother has already finished the sugar steamed cheese."
Shen Miao nodded: "My body is probably not fully recovered yet. I felt a little dizzy after walking two steps. I rested for a while on the way, so I came late."

Everyone in Rongjing Hall was silent for a moment.
Shen Yue wanted to say that she came late to ask for help, but she was not afraid to point out that Mrs. Shen relied on her elders to show off her old age and asked people to come to pay her respects regardless of her granddaughter's health.
After a while, Ren Wanyun said with a smile: "I think Xiao Wu is really weak. He has called the doctor twice in the past few days. Fortunately, he seems to be fine now."
"Are you feeling better?" A hoarse and stern voice sounded, with a hint of imperceptible impatience.
Shen Miao raised her head and looked at Mrs. Shen.
The smile on Mrs. Shen's face had disappeared, and she raised her head slightly arrogantly. She was clearly in her seventies, and she was wearing a peach pink brocade-buttoned narrow thin coat skirt, with green jade buttons on the collar, and a forehead embroidered with white orchid. Her silver hair was tied into an auspicious bun, dotted with jade beads.
She was a woman who was extremely particular about her appearance. In her previous life, during Shen Miao's boudoir period, she had always felt that Mrs. Shen was the most noble woman. She could not help but be fascinated by her elegant and beautiful temperament even in her later years, but now it seemed a bit ridiculous.
The first wife of General Shen, Shen Xin's mother was born into a well-known family and was a real lady. Unfortunately, she died of illness in middle age. Later, when General Shen passed by a certain place on the march, he rescued a singing girl from a gangster. The singing girl had nowhere to go, so she begged to be her concubine, and gave birth to Shen Gui and Shen Wan to General Shen, who was later rehabilitated.
The singer survived and became Mrs. Shen, and later became Mrs. Shen. His reputation and status have changed, but his appearance as a villain at heart remains unchanged. Shen Miao still remembered that in her previous life, Mrs. Shen forced her to marry the crippled King of Yuzhou, just to pave the way for Shen Qing.
She looked at the woman in front of her. Mrs. Shen was beautiful when she was young, with a pointed face and big, watery eyes. When she was old, she looked like a dry triangular drum head with two eyes standing abruptly on it. However, she refused to accept her fate and insisted on wearing brightly colored lipstick.
It's really... extremely immodest. Shen MiaoShe commented nonchalantly in her heart with the eyes of someone who had been a queen in her previous life, and said humbly: "I'm much better after taking the medicine. Thank you grandma for your concern."
The next second, Mrs. Shen above her head was heard shouting loudly: "Unfilial daughter, why don't you kneel down!"
